name: Lucas Proust
source:
[i]"I believe teaching is my soul's vocation, given to me by God."[/i]

[i]Believing in his fate to lead.[/i]

A teacher who travels to orphanages and other institutions to educate children. He often holds classes at the facility where the heroine lives. He is very polite and thoughtful, with a strong sense of justice. He regularly visits his younger sister at the hospital where she receives treatment for a serious illness. As a devout follower of God. he considers children to be precious gifts.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Teacher

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/vircheevermore/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
